payload.title: Configuration audit: P_final=8 for the paper; deploy ckpt (P=4, old route) is a stale legacy artifact

payload.question: P_final = 4 or 8? (GPT round-18, the only pre-manuscript technical item)
payload.rule_from_gpt: final checkpoint metadata is the source of truth for the reported experiment configuration

configs/platform2.yaml.data_dir: ../数据备份/软体平台数据/处理后的数据

findings.deploy/algorithms/tk_assets/transformer_: OLD ROUTE: KoopmanDynamics has a single fixed nn.Parameter A (no context MLP, no low-rank A(c) modulation); PatchTSTKoopmanModel = encoder -> fixed-A koopman -> linear decoder.
findings.deploy/algorithms/configs/transformer_ko: OLD ROUTE controller: LQR gains (Q_x1/Q_x2/alpha/R_control/ff_gain/u_limit), not RTI-MPC.
findings.deploy/export_assets.py: exports by copying a checkpoint from results/models/... and reading its config; no results/ dir exists in the repo.
findings.repo checkpoints: only ONE .pth in the repo: deploy/algorithms/tk_assets/model_assets/platform2_full_model.pth (the P=4 legacy one). No results/ or results/models/ directory exists; no P=8 checkpoint is checked in.

payload.experiments_actually_run: all Phase-2 gate experiments (A/B/AB ablation, rank sweep, rollout-aware, DirectNN, Gate-14C/14D RTI, matched oracle, theory diagnostics) trained their models from 处理后的数据 using configs/platform2.yaml -> P=8, n_layers=1.
payload.conclusion: P_final for the PAPER = 8 (config + every executed experiment). The bundled deploy checkpoint (P=4, n_layers=3) is a STALE LEGACY artifact imported from the previous project (论文4/code_project, ablation_platform2/20260514_084213) and implements the OLD route (fixed A + LQR); it was not used in any current experiment and cannot reproduce any new-route result.
required_actions: Train and save the final P=8 new-route model (history-conditioned low-rank A(c), rollout-aware scheduled training) as the paper's single model artifact; none currently exists in the repo.
Regenerate deploy assets (deploy/algorithms/tk_assets/model_assets/) from that P=8 checkpoint via deploy/export_assets.py.
Replace the old-route deploy stack (fixed-A KoopmanDynamics + LQR controller config) with the new-route model + RTI-SP controller before P2 hardware.
Then unify P=8 across paper tables / algorithm box / experiment description.
payload.classified_as: deployment-consistency defect (same family as ALN-010 residual / ALN-004): config vs artifact drift.
